contract.form: A complete answer must give the single exact value of d: either an integer n₀ ≥ 2 or +∞. A finite value requires establishing existence of such a bundle on P^{n₀} and nonexistence in every dimension 2 ≤ n < n₀; the value +∞ requires establishing nonexistence in every dimension n ≥ 2.
contract.not_enough: Bounds or a range for d, an example without ruling out all smaller eligible dimensions, nonexistence in only some dimensions, a conjectural or conditional value, or a statement that the value is unknown would not settle the question.
